column2: Layer the eggplant and mince in a baking dish and add tomato slices.
Add 1 glass of hot water and bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.
Baking the eggplant is lighter than frying it.
With rice pilaf and yogurt.
Islama köfte (köfte on broth-soaked bread)
2 cups meat stock
1 dessert spoon tomato paste
Knead the köfte mixture and shape flat köfte.
Cook on a grill or in a pan for 4 minutes on each side.
Boil the meat stock with the tomato paste.
Dip the pide slices in the stock and arrange on a plate.
Place the köfte on top and drizzle with butter.
The pide should soak up the hot stock briefly without turning doughy.
With tomatoes and peppers.
Köfte keeps 2 days in the fridge.
Kadınbudu köfte (lady’s thigh köfte)
Half a cup rice (boiled)
1 egg (for the mixture)
2 eggs (for coating)
1 dessert spoon salt, black pepper, cumin
Fry half the mince with the onion and let cool.
Knead with the remaining raw mince, rice, egg and spices.
Shape flat oval köfte.
Coat in flour, then in beaten egg.
Fry in hot oil for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Having half the mince cooked makes the köfte tender.
With mashed potatoes.
Haricot beans with meat
2 cups dried haricot beans (soaked overnight)
300 g diced beef
Pre-boil the beans for 30 minutes and drain.
Fry the meat in butter, then add the onion and tomato paste.
Add the beans and hot water.
Cook over low heat for 60 minutes until the beans are soft.
Add the salt in the last 10 minutes.
Adding salt early delays the beans softening.
With rice pilaf and pickles.
Ali Nazik kebab
1 dessert spoon salt, cumin, chilli flakes
Char the eggplants, peel and chop finely.
Mix the garlic yogurt with the eggplant.
Fry the mince with the spices in a pan, keeping it from clumping.
Spread the eggplant yogurt on a plate and put the mince in the middle.
Drizzle with chilli butter.
Draining the eggplant keeps the yogurt from turning watery.
The mince keeps 2 days in the fridge.
Oven-baked lamb chops
8 lamb chops
1 dessert spoon thyme, rosemary
Marinate the chops with oil, garlic and herbs for 30 minutes.
Heat the grill pan thoroughly.
Cook for 3–4 minutes on each side.
Sprinkle with salt after cooking.
Resting keeps the juices inside.
With roasted vegetables.
Beef and potato stew
Fry the meat until its liquid evaporates.
Cook with hot water for 45 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 20 more minutes.
Add the potatoes late so they don’t fall apart.
Cabbage rolls with minced meat
1 cabbage
1 dessert spoon salt, black pepper, mint
Blanch the cabbage leaves and shave down the thick ribs.
Knead the mince, rice, grated onion and spices.
Put filling on the leaves and roll up.
Arrange in a pot and add hot water with tomato paste, and butter.
Cover with a plate and cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
The plate keeps the rolls from unrolling.
With garlic yogurt.
Diced beef with green beans
400 g diced beef
Fry the meat, then add the onion and tomato paste.
Cook with 1 glass of water for 30 minutes.
Add the chopped beans and tomatoes.
Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
Remove the strings from the beans.
Beef pot roast
1 kg beef topside
1 dessert spoon thyme, salt, black pepper
1 cup meat stock
Rub the meat with the spices and sear every side in a very hot pot.
Add the coarsely chopped vegetables and garlic.
Add the meat stock and cover.
Cook over low heat for 2 hours, turning occasionally.
Rest, slice thinly and make a sauce from the juices.
Searing locks in the flavour.
Black-eyed beans with minced meat
Add the tomato paste.
Add the beans and water.
Cook for 25 minutes.
Black-eyed beans are among the quickest-cooking pulses.
Artichokes with meat
6 artichokes
300 g diced lamb
Fry the meat, then add the onion and carrot.
Cook with 1 glass of water for 25 minutes.
Add the artichokes and the lemon juice.
Cook for 20 more minutes.
Lemon keeps the artichokes from darkening.
Lamb shanks (oven-baked)
4 lamb shanks
Sear the shanks in a pot.
Place in a roasting dish with onion, tomato and garlic.
Add water and spices and cover with foil.
Bake at 170 °C for 2.5 hours.
Remove the foil and brown for 15 minutes.
It’s ready when the meat comes away from the bone.
With bulgur pilaf.
Boiled beef with vegetables
600 g beef on the bone
Bring the meat to the boil in water and skim off the foam.
Add the whole onion and cook for 60 minutes.
Add the coarsely chopped vegetables.
Cook for 25 more minutes.
Serve with lemon.
Skimming the foam keeps the broth clear.
Lavash wraps with minced meat and spinach
Spread the filling and kashar on the lavash and roll up.
Toast in a pan for 2 minutes on each side.
